title: The Bone Pile
text: A pile of bones outside a cave, higher than a man, picked clean and cracked for the marrow. Deer, horse, bear, and some that wore boots. The quarry eats well, and it is not afraid of being found.

options.label: The wisest reads what it eats, hoping to learn what it fears.

outcomes.text: Hunters, mostly. Lots of hunters. It is not afraid of you at all, and it never has been.

options.label: Use its own bones as bait, and draw it out to defend its larder.

outcomes.text: It comes to defend its larder, roaring, and it is bigger than the bones made it seem.

options.label: Search the bones for what the dead hunters carried. They will not mind.

outcomes.text: A good knife in a dead hand, and then the quarry's breath, hot and wet, on your neck.
